evidence.what: Integrated baseline run: 1,500 CRC + 600 cervical loops, noisy reviewer, process + NATS kills
evidence.result: CRC precision 1.000, recall 0.948, **0/563 false closures**. 0 duplicates or losses. Tamper 17/17 detected. Forged events 0/24 with effect. 0 wrong-patient sends.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: **Frozen final evaluation**: 5 seeds × 2 noise models; v2 is an independent corruption model never used for training or tuning; with the ungraded-prep query, the referral hand-off and 800 lung loops per run
evidence.result: Held-out v2 noise (code `e4c7553`): CRC P 1.000, R 0.737 (0.724–0.750), **0/2,090 false closures** (95% UB 0.18%), lung 0/1,463, 0/11,846 wrong-patient messages, 0/7,544 sent without consent, KPI error 0.034 vs EID-only 0.197, reviewer time 15.9 h per 1k loops, hand-off packets 233 of 236 (0 extra), review-load ratio across origins 1.19 pooled (per-seed 1.28, 1.11–1.45; under investigation). Dev noise: R 0.809, CRC 0/2,287, cervical 0/1,020, lung 0/1,506. Recall fell from 0.851 because reports that never grade prep now wait for the unit's grade (simulated). Disclosed post-hoc changes: τ 0.98 → 0.99 after one wrong-patient closure; the day-15 prep decision no longer skips pending histology (4 false closures in the first run at `b53ce89`); surname-variant and Emirates ID identity rules (about 10% less reviewer time, safety unchanged); hand-off packet fixes and two generator truth corrections after a trace of the misses; held-out noise model fix; MTSamples biopsy key correction; short surnames no longer corroborate alone (after 1 wrong-patient message in a run).
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: **Report readers on unseen text**: 7 more 300-report corpora by 4 model families (Claude, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon, Kimi K3.1 Pro), each frozen before any reader ran and each the fair test of the previous fix
evidence.result: 3 of 7 fair tests found an unsafe phrasing class: 6 of 211 automatic closures by the 26B were wrong (2.8%, UB 6.1%; 6/2,100 reports), 10 of 137 with the 4B. Each class fixed by a generic rule; reader v7.1 has 0 unsafe on all corpora; the last two fair tests (v7 on corpus 7, shipped v7.1 on corpus 8) passed with both readers. Pilot: shadow mode (clinician confirms every auto-closure) until 300 in a row are correct, then a 10% random audit; any error returns that class to shadow mode.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: Learn-then-Test gate, 12,600 calibration loops (cal split, v2 noise)
evidence.result: τ_close 0.99 certified with 0 false closures and 0 wrong-patient messages: P(both rates ≤ 0.1%) ≥ 95% for loops like the calibration set.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: 0 messages released without granted permission (stage 3: 0/619 released; 373 held until the grant).
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: HL7 v2 over MLLP, with connection drops and duplicate re-sends
evidence.result: 30,668/30,668 resources delivered exactly once; 888 duplicate re-sends absorbed; CRC 0/574 false closures.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: Local Gemma 3 4B reader, live in the integrated run
evidence.result: CRC P 1.000, R 0.955, 0/567 false closures; histology question 43/43.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: v7 gate offline sweep (5 seeds × 3 reviewer error rates)
evidence.result: Double review: **0/8,422 false closures**. Single review gives 21, so double review is mandatory.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: Caecum AUC 0.998; prep AUC 0.991 (specificity 0.83, so "adequate" only routes to a human). Integrated: 0/571 false closures, 0 upgrades.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: P 1.000, R 0.993, 0/297 false closures, recommendation accuracy 1.000.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: R@10 0.932 vs 0.604 (best single) and 0.928 (four combined). The gain over the combination is deployability (2.3 MB vs 236 MB), not accuracy.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: 94.5% KPI at 1.5 slots per FIT+. The optimiser ties greedy even when capacity is scarce, so we make no optimisation claim. Below 1 slot per FIT+, the queue collapses under any policy.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: At 1.2 slots per FIT+: direct-to-procedure plus prep targeting +13 pp ≤31-day completion (93% of draws better). Prep targeting frees about 88 repeat colonoscopies per 1,000. No lever helps below 1.0 slot.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: Network pooling, capacity misallocated across regions
evidence.result: ≤31 days for all FIT+ rises from 22.2% (no cross-site booking) to **42.1%** (pooled). No gain when capacity is short overall.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: Day-120 completion 22.5% → 40.7% with automated levers only (+18 pp); the base case uses +13 pp.
